// ServiceAuth: Shared secret for service-to-service calls to Content's internal endpoints (moderation-visibility, title lookup). Empty on purpose: provide via env ServiceAuth__Token outside local dev. When empty, only a valid JWT is accepted.
// Services: Downstream service endpoints. *.ServiceToken must match that service's ServiceAuth:Token. Provide via env (Services__NotificationApi__BaseUrl / __ServiceToken, Services__AuthApi__BaseUrl / __ServiceToken) outside local dev.
// ChapterPublishing: Background loop that publishes Scheduled chapters when their ScheduledAt passes. Enabled by default; set Enabled=false to turn it off for an instance.
